name: Note to the Mayor
summary: Abercrombie sends a message from western Duskwood to Darkshire, where its mayor awaits an unexpected delivery. He calls himself an old friend of Mayor Lord Ello Ebonlocke, but the note raises questions.

sections.title: A Friendly Message?
sections.body: After you recover Abercrombie’s stolen chest from the ogres at Vul'Gol Ogre Mound, the hermit sends you down the misty roads toward town. He laughs with delight and says he and Mayor Lord Ello Ebonlocke are old friends. Abercrombie insists the mayor will be as thrilled as he is when he learns what you have done.

sections.title: Puzzled Leadership
sections.body: At Darkshire’s town hall, Mayor Lord Ello Ebonlocke says he has never heard of Abercrombie. The parchment holds no greeting he can read. Its ancient script leaves the mayor baffled.

faq.q: Who sends the Note to the Mayor?
aliases: who gives note to the mayor
who starts note to the mayor
faq.answer: Abercrombie gives you the letter after you recover his stolen possessions from the local ogres. He lives alone in a shack on Duskwood’s western edge.

faq.q: Are Abercrombie and Mayor Ebonlocke actually friends?
aliases: is abercrombie friends with the mayor
faq.answer: No. Abercrombie calls them old acquaintances, but Mayor Lord Ello Ebonlocke has never heard of him and is baffled by the message.

faq.q: What is written in the note?
faq.answer: The note is written in an ancient, obscure language. Neither you nor Mayor Ebonlocke can decipher it, so he asks for help with a translation.

faq.q: Where is Lord Ello Ebonlocke located?
aliases: where do i turn in note to the mayor
faq.answer: Mayor Lord Ello Ebonlocke is inside the Darkshire Town Hall, on the east side of town along the main road in Duskwood.

faq.q: What happens after Mayor Ebonlocke receives the letter?
aliases: what is next after note to the mayor
what follows note to the mayor
faq.answer: Unable to read the mysterious script, Lord Ebonlocke asks you to find someone who can interpret it. He sends you to translate Abercrombie’s note.

faq.q: Why was Abercrombie laughing when he gave you the letter?
faq.answer: Abercrombie laughs with delight when he gives you the letter, but the text says nothing more about why. His claim of friendship leaves Darkshire’s mayor baffled.

angles.text: Darkshire’s safety depends on finding the cause of strange disturbances before they reach the Night Watch’s perimeter. The suspicious letter demands the attention of Alliance agents.
As a human courier serving the Night Watch and the House of Ebonlocke, you may find that the old hermit on Duskwood’s outskirts is not as straightforward as he seems.
